x: It should also be recorded that other notabilities on this stage were Sando, Driver, Heatley, O'Gorman, Keily and Ingles, all of whom beat the previous record and all of whom gained assistance in battling with the opposition.

Heatley came up from ninth to take over the lead and to lower the course record by 17 seconds, whilst Pat, despite an excellent run, was pushed back to eighth by other "big-guns", namely Connolly, Craig, Langridge, and Herring.
Mel Batty won in 48:13.4 which was 3rd fastest time ever, behind Heatley and Zatopek. It's good to see Colin Clair back in the Belgrave fold again.
In the unofficial top-ten cross country rankings for 1964, Gerry North was ranked 6th behind Batty, Hill, Turner, Cooke and Heatley despite beating three of them in the International Championship.
Geoff split the Coventry team most convincingly,beating Kilby,Taylor and Heatley,but had to give best to Adcocks (an easy winner) and Horne who beat Geoff in the run in.
Gerry Williams gained selection for the County team and finished an excellent 58th at Leicester, ahead of such runners as Hyman, Heatley and Bullivant.

The arrival at Godiva of Colin Kirkham and the revival of Kilby and Heatley were too much for the opposition, and although our team ran well it was evident early on that it was all in an effort to get second place.
